name: operation-row
title: OperationRow
description: Dense list of operations: method tag, path and meta. The selected row reveals its mock URL.

keyboard: Moves to each operation (link or button)
aria: The list has a label via OperationList label
The mock URL box sits outside the link so its copy button stays a separate control
a11y.notes: Use href for navigation and onSelect for in-page selection. Do not make the whole <li> clickable.
